correctness.rationale: The finite search enumerates all first-occurrence-normalized square-free words and prunes only exact terminal Abelian-square violations; a missing alphabet letter cannot occur in a maximal word. Both left and right maximality predicates compare exact integer Parikh vectors. Two different C++ implementations give zero full-support bicrucial words below length 16 and exactly four canonical length-16 representatives, each explicitly witnessed. Reproducible checker verifies all 7,421,303 canonical length-16 square-free words and matches the four outputs.

evidence: Cummings–Mays (2001) Theorem 2 gives a maximal construction and the length formula giving 19 at five letters, without claiming a five-letter minimum.
Bullock (2004) states bounds for large alphabet sizes and analyzes shorter construction patterns, not a complete length-16 five-letter census.
The accessible Korn (2003) abstract gives the bound 6k-10 for the large-alphabet range but not the five-letter enumeration.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Construction of one five-letter word or a weaker upper/lower bound does not imply that 16 is the exact minimum or that the four representatives are exhaustive. Korn full text remains an explicitly recorded coverage risk, not declared non-covering.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new statement has a conjunction of exact minimum length, four complete relabeling classes, and 480 labeled words. Known weaker minima, constructions and one-sided data do not entail it; the inaccessible relevant article is retained as a priority risk rather than being used as negative evidence.

originality.rationale: The examined complete primary sources treat four-letter exact extremizers, general bounds, and one-sided cruciality, none of which implies the exact five-letter two-sided length and four-orbit census. Multiple terminology and exact-parameter searches and semantic searches were carried out. Korn (2003) remains inaccessible and historically plausible, so the assessment is explicitly best-knowledge rather than definitive proof of priority.

value.rationale: This determines the first unresolved natural five-letter two-sided extremal case after the established four-letter census. Beyond providing one short example, it proves exact minimal length, full classification and 480 labeled extremizers, with reversal symmetries. Its statement is intrinsic to a standard extremal word-avoidance problem, not an arbitrary parameter tweak.
